statements.t: We estimate that TD affects approximately 800,000 people in the U.S., that approximately 90% of the 40,000 people in the U.S. affected by Huntington’s disease will develop chorea, that CAH affects at least 20,000 people in the U.S., and that hyperphagia in PWS affects approximately 10,000 people in the U.S.

estimates.name: Interest Rate Risk
estimates.t: We maintain a diversified investment portfolio consisting of low-risk, investment-grade debt securities with maturities of up to three years, including investments in commercial paper, securities of government-sponsored entities and corporate bonds that are subject to interest rate risk.

estimates.name: Forward-Looking Statements
estimates.t: This Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q contains forward-looking statements that involve a number of risks and uncertainties.

statements.t: R&D guidance reflects the continued advancement of the Company’s pre-clinical and clinical portfolio including the Phase 3 programs for osavampator in major depressive disorder and direclidine in schizophrenia, and includes approximately $33 million of expense for development milestones related to our in-licensed product candidates.
SG&A guidance reflects expense for ongoing commercial initiatives, including the recent expansion of our sales teams in Q1 2026, supporting INGREZZA growth and the launch of CRENESSITY and VYKAT XR.

When preparing the Non-GAAP financial results and guidance, the Company excludes certain GAAP items that management does not consider to be normal, including recurring cash operating expenses that might not meet the definition of unusual or non-recurring items.
The Company provides guidance regarding combined R&D and SG&A expenses on both a GAAP and a Non-GAAP basis.
